statement: For WebAI Bridge, optimizing X Website Traffic for Site Visit/Landing Page View produces higher-quality website traffic than optimizing for Link Clicks.

collection_context.fallback: purposeful public-web retrieval using the same H1, prioritizing X official comparison cases

intent.target_or_problem: Improve acquisition efficiency for en-japan's Web direct-response campaign (Middle no Tenshoku).
intent.evidence: The case states that the advertiser had used conversion optimization and introduced Site Visits Optimization to acquire users more efficiently.

test.before_or_control: Conversion optimization and Link Click optimization
test.after_or_challenge: Site Visits Optimization / landing-page arrival event
test.budget_or_window: several months of agency research; absolute spend not disclosed
test.evidence: Septeni reports evaluating Site Visits Optimization against existing optimization products and refining tag/event implementation.

outcome.evidence: The published case reports roughly 40% CPA improvement versus conversion optimization and roughly 50% versus Link Click optimization.

reasons: direct comparison with Link Click optimization
different product category and likely larger operating scale

intent.target_or_problem: Drive business audiences from X ads to SAP Concur whitepaper content and improve the efficiency of website visits.
intent.evidence: The case frames the opportunity as moving interested business audiences from X advertising to Concur.com content.

test.before_or_control: Link Click optimization and Conversion optimization
test.budget_or_window: X-funded advertiser testing during Nov-Dec 2021; absolute spend not disclosed
test.evidence: The success story explicitly compares Site Visits Optimization with Link Click and Conversion optimization.

outcome.evidence: The published case reports 88% lower cost per site visit versus Link Click optimization and 9% lower versus Conversion optimization.

intent.target_or_problem: Increase visits and interactions on Bloomberg.com from the existing X audience.
intent.evidence: Bloomberg set the goal of increasing website visits and driving traffic to feature articles.

test.before_or_control: Link Click optimization and Conversion optimization
test.budget_or_window: X-funded advertiser testing during Nov-Dec 2021; absolute spend not disclosed
test.evidence: The published case explicitly reports Site Visits Optimization results against Link Click and Conversion optimization.

outcome.evidence: The published case reports 87% lower cost per site visit versus Link Click optimization and 52% lower versus Conversion optimization.

reasons: media content rather than paid AI/IT service

intent.target_or_problem: Evaluate whether Site Visits Optimization can acquire completed website visits more efficiently than existing optimization models.
intent.evidence: X describes the product as optimizing delivery toward people most likely to visit the website.

test.before_or_control: Link Click optimization and Conversion optimization
test.held_constant: aggregate advertiser test details not fully disclosed
test.evidence: X reports product-test comparisons against existing optimization methods.

outcome.evidence: X reports average cost per site visit 67% lower than Link Click optimization and 31% lower than Conversion optimization.

reasons: not specific to Japan small-budget high-ticket AI service

invariant: External evidence sets hypothesis priority only. WebAI Bridge's own bounded campaign and authoritative LP/conversion evidence decide confirmation, refutation, and SCALE.
